headline: Willson Contreras delivers a late blast to sink the Braves as Tolle dominates
morning_brew: Payton Tolle was absolutely locked in last night down in Atlanta. Eight innings of two-run ball is exactly what this rotation needed after some shaky starts lately. Willson Contreras provided the heroics with that massive two-run home run in the eighth inning to pull us ahead for good. It was a gutsy win for a team that has been searching for some momentum on this road trip. Aroldis Chapman made it interesting with those two walks, but he slammed the door shut to secure the three to two victory.

The roster shuffle continues as Nick Sogard gets the call to join the big club. It is always tough to see a veteran go down with an injury like a sports hernia, but that is the reality of a long season. This team is nineteen and twenty-six, fighting to stay in the mix while dealing with constant lineup changes. We need the guys who are healthy and active to find some consistency at the plate. It is a long way to October and the clock is ticking.

Offseason talk is dominating the airwaves at the Hub while the basketball and hockey teams are on the outside looking in. Those rumors about a massive trade for a superstar in the frontcourt are everywhere, but I will believe it when the paperwork is filed. Management has a wicked long list of needs to address before next winter. We are looking for players who can handle the pressure of playing in this town when the lights are the brightest. We need guys with grit who show up when it matters.
